title: pvExtractCellsByType
body:
## pvExtractCellsByType

Keeps only the cells whose VTK cell type is listed in CellTypes, e.g. the Tetrahedron cells of a mixed mesh, or the Triangle and Quadrilateral faces of a surface. The output has the same dataset type as the input; structured inputs (image, rectilinear or structured grids) consist of one cell type, so they come through either whole or empty. Use pvExtractSelection to pick cells by ID or value instead.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- No type is selected until you list one, and an empty selection gives an empty output.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ExtractCellsByType`. Identity: `filters/ExtractCellsByType`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CellTypes` | Select the cell types to extract. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
